description: This file defines the TokenStream class in the Twig templating engine, providing functionality to buffer, access, and manipulate a stream of tokens during template parsing.

classes.name: TokenStream
classes.description: A class that manages a stream of tokens for parsing templates, allowing token navigation, lookahead, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TokenStream with an array of tokens and an optional source object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the token stream into a newline-separated string of token representations.

methods.name: injectTokens
methods.description: Inserts additional tokens at the current position in the stream.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token in the stream and returns the previous token.

methods.name: nextIf
methods.description: Tests the current token with provided criteria, advances if matched, and returns the token or null.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Validates the current token against expected type and value, advances the stream, or throws a syntax error.

methods.name: look
methods.description: Peeks ahead in the token stream without advancing.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests the current token against specified criteria.

methods.name: isEOF
methods.description: Checks if the end of the token stream is reached.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context associated with the token stream.
